model: Qwen/Qwen3-14B (revision as recorded in /root/gate2a/run_header.json, from Gate 2a)
status: frozen before any M7 data for this model

protocol.code: buttons_chunk12b.py sections 1-3 (and 4-5 for unsteered) verbatim; only the model and paths differ
protocol.formats: unsteered: chat and plain; steered: chat only
protocol.environment: /root/gate2a/.venv-tl (transformers 4.57.6, torch 2.11.0+cu128): the environment of Gate 2a R2a, required by the steering gate
protocol.gpu: A100 (same GPU type as R2a, required by the steering gate)

steering.vector: the paper's published S2 vector (results/3.2_pain_vectors/pain_vectors/Qwen_3_14B_base/pain_vectors.pt, layer 31). Gate 2a: our layer-31 vector matches it at cosine 0.99994; the tie-break layer-32 vector changes behaviour, so the published layer-31 vector is used.
steering.layer: 20, the paper's steering layer for this model (its ladder's automatic pick; reproduced in Gate 2a)
steering.dose: vector scaled so that coefficient 1 equals a vector-to-residual ratio of 0.5908 (the 4B convention), the ratio measured with the paper's own method (final-token residual norm at layer 20, first 3 neutral prompts). Coefficient +/-0.5 = ratio +/-0.295, as in Gate 1.
steering.random_directions: three, seeds 1103, 2207, 3301: torch.randn(5120, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)), normalised, scaled to the scaled S2 norm
steering.hook: forward hook on decoder layer 20 adding coeff * vector (bf16) at every position (the paper's ladder arithmetic)
steering.gate: before any steered trial: Gate 2a R2a's generation at coefficient -2, prompt 0 (raw published vector) must regenerate token-identically

decision_rules.steered_arms: run only if unsteered chat V1 >= 0.90 (G10)
decision_rules.harm_arm: run only if unsteered chat V5 (harm share among valid P3 first choices) <= 0.10
decision_rules.arms: P0, P1, P2 under S2 +0.5, S2 -0.5, random_1103/2207/3301 +0.5; P3 under S2 +0.5 and the three random +0.5 (if the harm arm runs)

statistics: paired by trial id; per-scenario mean of paired differences; 95% CI from 20000 bootstrap resamples of the 101 scenarios, seed 20260925. 'Beyond each random direction' means the paired difference against every one of the three random conditions separately has a CI excluding 0 in the stated direction.

predictions.G11a: P1 relief log-prob share (p_target): S2 +0.5 minus unsteered < 0, AND S2 +0.5 minus each random +0.5 < 0
predictions.G11b: P1 relief log-prob share: S2 -0.5 minus unsteered > 0, AND S2 -0.5 minus each random +0.5 > 0
predictions.G12: deflection over P0-P2: S2 +0.5 minus unsteered > 0, AND S2 +0.5 minus each random +0.5 > 0
predictions.G13: if the harm arm runs: P3 harm log-prob share (p_harm): S2 +0.5 minus unsteered > 0 (the source paper's direction)
predictions.G14: if the harm arm runs: P3 p_harm: S2 +0.5 minus each random +0.5 > 0

reported: sampled versions of G11 and G13
the raw vector's measured ratio vs published 0.5408
context: G11a/G11b/G12 are Gate 1 exploratory findings on Qwen3.5-4B (one random direction), now frozen as predictions with three random directions; G13/G14 repeat Gate 1's Amendment 1 (H1 trivially positive, H2 failed at 4B).
